title: Transcript tool-segment grouping and terminal-canvas containment
objective: Render consecutive heterogeneous tool calls between visible LLM/user text as one reversible container while keeping exact member order, abnormal attention, retained evidence, and terminal-safe output.
requirements: Build transcript segments independently from same-family ObservationAggregate state and before PresentationHidden or viewport filtering.
Use visible transcript text and session/actor/work-unit changes as boundaries; invisible internal tool-round TurnID changes do not split a segment.
Preserve call-anchor order when concurrent results complete out of order and reveal every older D0-hidden member when the segment opens.

Keep single tools unwrapped; group every consecutive non-Agent multi-tool run regardless of disclosure level or outcome; keep live work open and default settled segments collapsed; reveal each member's structured detail and retained diff when the group opens; support mouse and keyboard group toggles.
Treat narrow literal HTTP GET/HEAD shell commands as read-only for display without weakening execution permissions; retain conservative structured display for mutation or ambiguity.
Strip terminal controls before width bounding, suppress cursor-oriented terminal canvases from default details, retain exact evidence, and render the root on an opaque background.
Resolve every new visible label through semantic i18n keys for all runtime languages.
write_scope: TUI transcript projection, shell presentation projection, bundled go-tui background inheritance, focused tests, and verification evidence

cost.note: Actual human time is not inferred from agent runtime telemetry.

acceptance.criterion: A real tool-call/result sequence renders one mixed container and remains in invocation order after reverse result completion.
Visible text and identity form correct boundaries while invisible internal turns do not.

Expansion restores every D0-hidden call and every structured member detail, including retained edit diffs; long segments are not viewport-truncated; settled alert and side-effect groups default collapsed.
Mouse and keyboard group controls are reversible and localized headers update at render time.
Read-only weather curl folds, mutation remains structured, terminal art is suppressed, plain colored output is retained safely, and background cells are opaque.

verification.note: Fresh full-root runs compiled and passed task-owned packages but failed unrelated exact-string/runtime/session tests from concurrent shared-worktree migrations; see TERMINAL_MATRIX.md.

remaining_risks: Manual fullscreen validation in the user's exact terminal/tmux theme remains separate from automated buffer and event-sequence tests.
Non-tool operational transcript rows intentionally remain hard visual boundaries.
The current full-root suite is not release-green because unrelated concurrent shared-worktree changes have failing tests.

result.summary: Heterogeneous consecutive calls now form one reversible transcript segment, settled runs stay compact with alert-bearing headers, abnormal and structured member details remain available on expansion, terminal canvases cannot leak into default prose, and the root background is opaque.
